## Report Stage

**Purpose:** Deterministically merge audited insights into the final DOCX/LaTeX/PDF report with a PRISMA-style flow summary.

**TODO:**
1. Postgres node: fetch all clusters + insights for the project.
2. Execute Command: `python3 python/sidecar/report_export.py --project-name "..." --out /data/exports/report.docx`.
3. Respond to Chat Trigger / webhook with the download link or file.

No LLM call in this stage — pure deterministic merge of already-audited content.
